text: 央行发布银罚决字〔2026〕71号，对国投证券股份有限公司予以警告，并罚款81.8万元，作出行政处罚决定日期为2026年6月22日。违法行为有：1.未按照规定开展客户尽职调查；2.未按照规定报告可疑交易；3.未按照规定开展洗钱风险评估或者健全相应的风险管理制度。
text_en: The PBOC issued Yin Fa Jue Zi No. [2026] 71, issuing a warning to SDIC Securities Co., Ltd. and imposing a fine of RMB 818,000. The date of the administrative penalty decision was June 22, 2026. The illegal acts are: 1. Failure to conduct customer due diligence in accordance with regulations; 2. Failure to report suspicious transactions in accordance with regulations; 3. Failure to conduct money laundering risk assessments in accordance with regulations or improve corresponding risk management systems.
